counters.name: Fire
counters.description: The fire mages' share of the elemental balance: the four start at 25 of 100. An orb dropped on an orb platform moves 1 from the orb's element to the platform's.

offerings.name: Fire Orb on the Fire Orb Platform
offerings.message: Dropping a fire orb will do no good here.

offerings.name: Water Orb on the Fire Orb Platform

checks.refusal: You get the sense that the water mages are already weakened enough.

offerings.message: You drop the water orb onto the fire platform...you sense something powerful has just happened...

announce.text: You feel the water magic within you weaken.
You feel the fire magic within you grow stronger.
